title: Jan23 demonstrations in Warsaw and Kraków in support of Alexei Navalny
notes: The opened Polish Radio/PAP-IAR account says participants demanded Navalny’s release, release of political prisoners, an end to repression, and the right to peaceful assembly in Russia. It reports a dozen or so (kilkunastu) in Warsaw and about 100 in Kraków; those separate site counts are not summed. No demand directed to the Polish government or its policy is reported, so the documented actions fall outside the own-state-target rule.
